q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month, and annual billing saves you 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month. For 5 people, the monthly total would be $40.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: You can keep up to 100 notes on the free plan.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number to process the refund.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase, so I cannot process a refund for a Plus subscription bought three weeks ago. I can open a support ticket for you if you would like to discuss this further.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no native Linux desktop app, but Linux users can access the service through the web app.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes supports Android 12 or later. Android 11 is not supported.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs an internet connection. The mobile and desktop apps work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export and select the PDF option. We will email all your notes as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS is not supported. You can only use authenticator apps for two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the Free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep paid features until the end of the current billing period. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States. They are encrypted both at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%. This discount applies to our subscription plans.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: The Plus plan allows you to use up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know. Would you like me to open a support ticket so a human can help you?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know as the FAQ doesn't cover importing from Evernote. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: There is currently no Linux desktop app available, but Linux users can access the web app. I don't have information on future release dates. Would you like me to open a support ticket to inquire about it?

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan includes shared workspaces.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, the file size limit is 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページの「パスワードを忘れた」をクリックしてください。30分で有効期限が切れるリセットリンクをメールでお送りします。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: Please check your Trash folder, as deleted notes are stored there for 30 days and can be restored. If you need further assistance recovering data, please reply with your order number or account details so we can open a support ticket for you. I apologize for the frustration.
